title: Three Companies Have Notified the SEC of Intention To Start Tokenized Stocks Trading
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Three Companies Have Notified the SEC of Intention To Start Tokenized Stocks Trading The Securities and Exchange Commission is taking applications from companies wanting to list tokenized stocks. This post Three Companies Have Notified the SEC of Intention To Start Tokenized Stocks Trading first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
